Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Durango Colorado hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 10, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 15 Durango Colorado hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 4, the hotel's own site at 3, KAYAK.com at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1. Taxes and fees at Durango Colorado hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at General Palmer Hotel to 17% at Holiday Inn & Suites Durango Downtown by IHG. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
